nodes.label: Runtime OS tier selection
nodes.rationale: A single branch carries every machine; the OS tier is chosen at runtime via uname -s. This retired the branch-per-OS model (main=macOS, cachyos-home=Linux) and its never-merge-wholesale footgun, which is impossible now that OS files live in disjoint tier dirs.

nodes.label: Backup-then-link deployment
nodes.rationale: One shared primitive (_link_one) for both deploy modes: correct symlink is a no-op, anything else is moved to <dst>.bak.<timestamp> (numeric suffix on collision) and never rm -rf'd, so deploy is idempotent and rollback is per-app.

nodes.label: Package script identity convention
nodes.rationale: Filename minus .sh must equal the identifier the manager lists by (leaf name for brew/pacman/yay, full dotted id for winget) so the skip-check recognises an installed package instead of reinstalling it every run.

nodes.label: Runtime state excluded from Git
nodes.rationale: Whole-dir ~/.config/<app> symlinks mean anything an app writes (e.g. zsh's .zshrc.zwc) lands in the repo tree, so runtime paths must be gitignored or redirected to ~/.local/state/<app>/.

nodes.label: Tweaks source lib/link.sh themselves
nodes.rationale: Tweaks run as separate processes, so setup.sh's own source of lib/link.sh does not reach them; zsh.sh sources it itself to reuse _link_backup_path, giving ~/.zshrc, ~/.zprofile and a differing ~/.zshenv the same non-colliding <file>.bak.<timestamp> backup names.

nodes.label: Gitleaks pre-commit secret hook
nodes.rationale: The conventional deny-list .gitignore no longer gates tracking by directory, so the gitleaks pre-commit hook is the primary content-level secret defense; the brew module installs pre-commit/gitleaks and the pre-commit tweak installs the hook in the self-resolved repo root, failing loudly if pre-commit is missing.
